h1: Empowering Fiji Businesses with 24/7 AI Agents
sub: Equip your business with autonomous cloud workers that browse websites, run code, connect with your apps, and manage Telegram operations around the clock.
audience: Resort and hospitality operators in Nadi and Denarau, logistics coordinators in Suva, agro-exporters across Viti Levu, and regional consulting teams.
manifesto: Across Pacific time zones, business never pauses. Ceyo provides Fiji teams with tireless cloud agents that research, run code, and automate operations around the clock, keeping local enterprises connected to global markets without burning out.

uses.d: Autonomous browser bots audit travel portal rates, capture reservation inquiries, and draft guest itinerary emails around the clock.
Agents track inter-island shipping schedules, extract container manifests from emails, and sync logs directly into Google Sheets.
Bots monitor international commodity price boards, summarize customs documentation, and alert your sales team on Telegram.
Extract policy briefs, regional trade agreements, and donor updates across multiple Pacific portals into comprehensive reports.
Local developers write, run, and test Python automations inside dedicated cloud machines without relying on local power continuity.
Connect CRMs, Notion, and Gmail into automated sequences handled collaboratively by a specialized team of Telegram bots.

steps.d: Choose pre-configured browser, coding, or research agents tailored to your business needs.
Connect Gmail, Notion, Google Sheets, or Telegram group chats in just a few clicks.
Let your agents handle recurring tasks, monitor data, and execute cloud jobs even while you sleep.

chapters.d: Your Suva team wakes up to structured summaries of overnight overseas emails and supply inquiries prepared in Telegram. The cloud bot highlights high-priority client requests without manual sorting.
While your team handles meetings in Nadi, browser agents check regional airline timetables and hospitality rates. Any unexpected price shifts are automatically flagged in your central dashboard.
A specialized group of Telegram bots drafts exporter compliance forms and runs calculation scripts in their cloud sandbox. Your staff reviews and approves the outputs with a single message.
Your laptops and mobile phones power down for the night, but Ceyo continues processing scheduled data tasks. Independent cloud computers keep working uninterrupted through every time zone.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost in Fiji and is there a free trial?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three subscription tiers: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every plan begins with a 3-day free trial providing up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; your linked card is charged only when the trial ends unless cancelled.

faq.q: Do my AI agents stay active when my device is switched off?
faq.a: Yes. Each Ceyo bot operates on its own dedicated cloud computer, meaning all browser tasks, coding routines, and monitoring schedules run 24/7 regardless of your internet connection or battery status.

faq.q: Can I manage Ceyo agents directly inside Telegram?
faq.a: Yes. You can chat with your personal bot one-on-one or add several specialized bots into a Telegram group chat, enabling them to collaborate on complex research, data entry, and project workflows.

faq.q: Which business applications can Ceyo connect with?
faq.a: Ceyo integrates with more than 1,000 popular services including Google Sheets, Gmail, Slack, Notion, calendars, and leading CRM systems to automate end-to-end administration.

faq.q: Can Ceyo agents handle multiple languages and voice interactions?
faq.a: Ceyo handles standard English fluently along with global business languages, and supports voice and video calls alongside phone-call automation for flexible communication.
